description: Energy Statistics India 2025 brings together energy reserves, installed capacity, production, consumption and trade. The official release describes energy balances, sustainable-energy indicators and a new energy-accounts chapter using SEEA 2012. The provider is National Statistics Office, Ministry of Statistics and Programme Implementation. Coverage: Coverage is India, with the new accounts covering financial years 2022–2023 and 2023–2024. Other series and comparisons extend to earlier years and use their own boundaries. Access: The official Hindi publication announcement and detailed scope were read. The yearbook’s numerical tables were not downloaded. Licence and cost: The page does not establish a reuse licence or complete cost conditions. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: Renewable potential, installed capacity and actual generation are distinct quantities. The announcement cannot replace the full tables and their footnotes. For simulation it supplies national energy-balance, demand and asset-accounting context. Related resources: No existing catalogue record explicitly covers the named 2025 yearbook.
